what: On hover, a translucent film fills the button from the left (pill: .32s starting from .75, square button: .2s from 0), and on release it rewinds toward the same side in .32s — text color stays the same, so it works on pale buttons too

options.from: Starting scaleX of the curtain, default 0.75 (the square button original is 0)
options.in: Rise duration (s), default 0.32 (original square button is 0.2)
options.--fx-fill: Curtain color (via style), default background color at 30%
options.[data-fx-part=rect]: Curtain (child) — if none, the part inserts one at the front and removes it on detach

from.where: shared.js [data-sweep] · .jo-rect of the mint button · Play Movie pill · More button (original .rect of .button.blue · .playmovie · .more)
